title: fix(worker): stSoftwareAU/GRQ-AutoTrader keeps failing at setup — runs die in the first minute
body:
<!-- VIBE_REPO_FAST_FAILURE_TALLY:stSoftwareAU/GRQ-AutoTrader -->

Auto-filed by the Vibe Coder (Issue #2956): **stSoftwareAU/GRQ-AutoTrader** is being tallied for fast failures across the fleet. Every host adds a marker comment here each time its own run fails fast against this repository (inside 60s, or before any output at all).

When 3 fast failures fall inside a rolling 24 h window the back-off marker is added to this issue, and every host then skips stSoftwareAU/GRQ-AutoTrader until this issue is closed (Issue #2955).

Closing this issue releases the back-off; a fresh tally starts from the next fast failure.
